title: AI Is Not Changing Professions. AI Is Changing Processes
h1: AI Is Not Changing Professions. AI Is Changing Processes

cover.alt: A person designing a system in which several AI agents work together

tldr: Results depend less on the model than on the process around it: context, roles, Skills, MCP, validation, and feedback. AI amplifies a specialist's capabilities, but it does not make product decisions for them.
